# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on `main` receives fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report security issues in public GitHub issues.

Report vulnerabilities privately using GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting:
<https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/turtlebot3-ai-service-robot/security/advisories/new>

If you cannot use GitHub advisories, email `andrew.abdelmalak3@gmail.com` with:

- The affected file or component (`planning/` or `ros/tb3_service_robot/`)
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Potential impact
